def binary_search(arr, target):
    low = 0                      # start of the search area
    high = len(arr) - 1          # end of the search area

    while low <= high:           # keep going while something remains
        mid = low + (high - low) // 2   # safe middle point
        if arr[mid] == target:   # middle value matches
            return mid           # we found it
        elif arr[mid] < target:  # target is bigger
            low = mid + 1        # search the right half
        else:                    # target is smaller
            high = mid - 1       # search the left half

    return -1                    # target is not in the list
